cost: Let N be total input bytes, L the line count, B selected bytes, T token characters and Bout output bytes. Whole-call time is O(N+L+B+T+Bout), excluding opaque annotation and I/O latency. Whole-call retained memory is O(N+L+B+Bout) plus token and annotator storage; N accounts for prep retaining the full raw input even when selection is short.

inverse: On finite tokens, exclude a range containing an out-of-bounds index, overlapping ranges, or lost tokens. On malformed marker order exclude a successful extraction or parser acquisition. Oracle: partition enumeration and reversed-marker public rejection.

For ranges Q, retain all token forms producing Q; sentence ranges cannot reconstruct words. Oracle: whitespace variants and heading cut fixtures.
